question:
The following bar graph represents the flow of funds of XYZ India Pvt. Ltd from 2015-2020. Calculate the percentage of average rate (approx.) of the increase in funds from 2015-2017.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41bf03a3b7b07bbdbd6f413dadc260d2b306d06e0d3f527799ab35018eb1228b.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Funds in 2015 = ₹22.77 Crores

Funds in 2017 = ₹29.52 Crores

**Formula used:**

Percentage Increase = dfrac{({Current Year Funds - Previous Year Funds})}{{Previous Year Funds}} × 100

**Calculations:**

Percentage increase from 2015 to 201:

⇒ dfrac{(29.52 - 22.37)}{22.37} × 100

⇒ 31.96%

Average rate of increase:

⇒ dfrac{31.96%}{2} 

⇒ 15.98 ≈ 16%

**∴ The average rate of increase in funds from 2015-2017 is approximately 16%%.**
